//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the LOADER-OVERLAY utility (keen `Loader.loader_overlay/1`, svelte `feedback/LoaderOverlay.svelte`). SCOPE: CONTAINER ONLY — an absolutely-positioned backdrop overlay (.pa-loader-overlay) that centers a spinner over a positioned parent. Like loader-center.json, the harness feeds the slot plain TEXT (HTML-escaped), so the real child (a spinner) can't flow through; the body is a bare text token. This fixture proves ONLY the container: its <div> tag, its pa-loader-overlay class, and its class passthrough. NOTE on the empty slot: keen's loader_overlay/1 renders a FALLBACK <.spinner /> when the slot is TRULY ABSENT, whereas svelte renders nothing; the harness dumper always passes a (possibly empty-string) slot, so the fallback never fires here and both wrappers emit the bare container. keen's fallback is verified in its own loader_test.exs, not as a shared golden. Authored from dist/css/main.css + snippets/loaders.html + _loaders.scss.

propsVocabulary.body: the overlaid content area — filled with plain slot text in this container-only slice (the real spinner child is out of scope)

goldenConventions: Structural only. .pa-loader-overlay is a bare absolutely-positioned flex-centering <div> with NO modifiers (grep '\.pa-loader-overlay--' on main.css is empty). The body slot is a plain text token. Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away.
